chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint left-strafes then briefly right-strafes through a sandstone corridor while beginning the M4A1-S reload, the weapon raised and magazine being removed.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角向左横移后短暂向右横移，穿越砂岩走廊，同时开始对M4A1-S换弹，武器抬起、弹匣正在取出。
chunks.movement: mixed movement (left strafe -> right strafe -> still)
environment_focus: sandstone corridor walls with carved hieroglyphic reliefs
bright blue sky visible through an archway at screen-left

chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint stands still in the sandstone corridor while the M4A1-S reload continues mid-animation, the weapon body and green-gloved hands prominent at screen-center.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角静止于砂岩走廊中，M4A1-S换弹动画持续进行，武器主体与绿色手套在画面中央清晰可见。
environment_focus: carved sandstone wall with hieroglyphic inscriptions at screen-right
recessed archway opening to exterior daylight at screen-left

chunks.description_en: Still standing then right-strafing, the first-person viewpoint continues the M4A1-S reload while a rightward yaw turn reveals a narrow doorway and additional sandstone wall panels ahead.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角先静止后向右横移，继续M4A1-S换弹，向右偏转视角后可见前方一处窄门洞及更多砂岩墙面。
chunks.view_change: right yaw turn revealing a narrow doorway opening in the sandstone wall
environment_focus: narrow rectangular doorway in sandstone wall at screen-center
carved relief panels on interior walls
warm directional sunlight casting hard shadows

chunks.description_en: Right-strafing with continued rightward yaw turns, the first-person viewpoint completes the M4A1-S reload and returns to a ready hold, the corridor's tiled floor and doorway now centered in view.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角向右横移并持续向右偏转视角，完成M4A1-S换弹并恢复持枪待机，走廊铺砖地面与门洞居于画面中央。
chunks.view_change: right yaw turn centering on a doorway with tiled floor visible beyond
environment_focus: tiled floor with red-bordered geometric pattern at screen-bottom
sandstone doorway arch framing exterior blue sky
worn stone wall surface with carved motifs

chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint performs rapid alternating left and right strafes while holding the reloaded M4A1-S at ready, facing a sandstone corridor with a small window opening to bright exterior daylight.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角持续快速左右交替横移，手持已换弹完毕的M4A1-S保持待机，面向砂岩走廊，一扇小窗透出明亮的室外光线。
environment_focus: small rectangular window opening in sandstone wall with bright exterior sky beyond
tiled floor with red-edged geometric border pattern
amber sandstone walls with carved hieroglyphic reliefs

subject_list.subject_attribute: Green-gloved hands grip a white-patterned M4A1-S held at the lower-right screen anchor in a standard two-handed carry; gloves are teal-green, weapon skin is light with dark geometric markings; CT side per metadata.

environment_detail.area_or_callout: interior sandstone corridor, specific callout not confirmed
environment_detail.opening_view: A wide-FOV first-person view at standing eye height looks along a sandstone interior corridor; the left side opens through a tall archway to bright blue exterior sky, while the right and forward walls are close-set carved sandstone panels bearing hieroglyphic relief inscriptions; the floor is warm amber stone; the corridor is narrow, roughly one-to-two body widths wide.
environment_detail.layout_and_sightlines: The corridor runs roughly forward with a turn or junction ahead; a narrow doorway or window in the far sandstone wall provides a sightline to an exterior area with blue sky; the left archway opening is a secondary sightline to outside; the corridor is enclosed on the right by a continuous sandstone wall; no visible stairs or elevation change; cover is limited to the wall edges flanking the doorway.
environment_detail.surfaces_and_materials: Walls are smooth-to-rough sandstone in warm amber and tan tones with carved hieroglyphic and geometric relief patterns; the floor transitions from plain stone to a tiled section with a red-bordered geometric border pattern visible in later frames; the ceiling is stone; surfaces show mild wear and color variation consistent with aged stone.
environment_detail.props_and_interactables: No crates, barrels, or dropped weapons visible; a small rectangular window opening appears in the far sandstone wall; no doors, shutters, or interactive props observed.
environment_detail.lighting_and_visibility: Bright outdoor daylight enters from the left archway and the far window, casting hard directional shadows on the interior walls; the corridor interior is well-lit with warm ambient bounce from the sandstone surfaces; no smoke, fire, or flash obstruction; visibility is clear throughout.
environment_detail.hud_and_overlay: Standard CS2 HUD present: crosshair at screen-center, health and armor indicators at lower-left, ammo counter at lower-right, radar at upper-left, weapon icon visible; no scoreboard or kill feed observed.

segments.visual_description_long: A narrow sandstone corridor on de_anubis fills the frame at standing eye height, its walls densely carved with hieroglyphic relief panels in warm amber and tan stone. Screen-left, a tall archway opens to bright blue exterior sky; screen-right and ahead, continuous sandstone walls close the lane to roughly one-to-two body widths. The floor is plain stone near the opening, transitioning to a tiled section with a red-bordered geometric border pattern visible in the later portion of the clip. Hard directional sunlight enters from the left archway and a small rectangular window in the far wall, casting defined shadows across the interior surfaces. <Camera1>The first-person viewpoint turns rightward during the middle portion of the clip, centering on the narrow doorway in the far sandstone wall and revealing the tiled floor pattern below.</Camera1> By the final frames the view settles facing the corridor's far end, the small window framing a patch of bright exterior sky against the carved stone surround.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action1><|Subject1|> performs a full M4A1-S reload: removing the spent magazine, inserting a fresh magazine, and cycling the action to return the weapon to a ready hold.</Action1>.

subject_list.display_name: 由玩家操控的 CS2 特工
subject_list.subject_attribute: 绿色手套双手握持一把白色花纹M4A1-S，武器锚定于画面右下方，采用标准双手持枪姿势；手套为青绿色，武器皮肤为浅色配深色几何纹样；根据元数据为CT方。

environment_detail.area_or_callout: 砂岩室内走廊，具体战术点位未经确认
environment_detail.opening_view: 以站立视角高度的宽视野第一人称视角沿砂岩室内走廊望去；左侧通过一道高大拱门开向明亮的蓝色室外天空，右侧与正前方为近距离的雕刻砂岩墙面，刻有象形文字浮雕；地面为暖琥珀色石材；走廊狭窄，宽约一至两个玩家身位。
environment_detail.layout_and_sightlines: 走廊大致向前延伸，前方有转角或交叉口；远处砂岩墙上的窄门洞或窗口提供通向室外蓝天区域的视野；左侧拱门开口为通向室外的次要视野；右侧为连续砂岩墙封闭；无可见楼梯或高度变化；掩体仅限于门洞两侧墙角。
environment_detail.surfaces_and_materials: 墙面为暖琥珀色与棕褐色调的光滑至粗糙砂岩，带有雕刻的象形文字与几何浮雕图案；地面从普通石材过渡至后期帧可见的带红色边框几何图案的铺砖区域；天花板为石材；表面呈现与古旧石材一致的轻微磨损与色彩变化。
environment_detail.props_and_interactables: 无可见箱子、桶或掉落武器；远处砂岩墙上有一扇小矩形窗口；未观察到门、卷帘或可交互道具。
environment_detail.lighting_and_visibility: 明亮的室外日光从左侧拱门和远处窗口射入，在室内墙面投下硬朗的定向阴影；走廊内部因砂岩表面的暖色漫反射而光线充足；无烟雾、火焰或闪光遮挡；全程能见度清晰。
environment_detail.hud_and_overlay: 标准CS2 HUD可见：准星位于画面中央，生命值与护甲显示于左下角，弹药计数于右下角，雷达于左上角，武器图标可见；未观察到记分板或击杀提示。
environment_detail.persistent_world_effects: 无可见持续性世界特效。

segments.visual_description_long: de_anubis地图上一条狭窄的砂岩走廊以站立视角高度充满画面，墙面密布暖琥珀色与棕褐色调的象形文字浮雕。画面左侧，一道高大拱门开向明亮的蓝色室外天空；画面右侧与正前方，连续砂岩墙将通道收窄至约一至两个身位宽。地面在开口处为普通石材，在片段后半段过渡为带红色边框几何图案的铺砖区域。强烈的定向日光从左侧拱门和远处砂岩墙上的小矩形窗口射入，在室内表面投下清晰阴影。<Camera1>第一人称视角在片段中段向右转动，将远处砂岩墙上的窄门洞居中，并显露出下方的铺砖地面图案。</Camera1>至最后几帧，视角稳定朝向走廊远端，小窗将一片明亮的室外天空框于雕刻石材之间。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action1><|Subject1|>执行完整的M4A1-S换弹动作：取出空弹匣，插入新弹匣，完成上膛后恢复持枪待机状态。</Action1>。
